His new job at a high-rise building was __________ than the work he did before.
The practical examination was __________ than the theory exam.
The practical sessions were __________ than the theory classes.
The marketing team in her new job was __________ than the team she worked with before.
The design exhibition by the seniors this year was __________ than the exhibition held last year.

activity_b.text: At the beauty contest, the first runner-up was more beautiful than the winner.
It was more practical to cook once a week than to cook daily.
It was more economical to buy some groceries wholesale than in smaller quantities.
They wanted a more modern house than their current house.
The new technician was more efficient than the previous one and could manage the repairs and office administration.
His new job at a high-rise building was more dangerous than the work he did before.
The practical examination was more difficult than the theory exam.
The practical sessions were more interesting than the theory classes.
The marketing team in her new job was more professional than the team she worked with before.
The design exhibition by the seniors this year was more impressive than the exhibition held last year.

Why did Kavindya prefer the bamboo paddle?
What problem did two pH testing spoons have?
options: They were from the older batch.

Questions.question: Which thermometer model was more accurate?

activity_b.text: Good morning, Kavindya. I need to review our supply checklist for this week.
What are you doing now?
Good morning, madam. I’m updating the processing logs from yesterday.
Several items ran out during the dough preparation and temperature-control tasks.
Yes, yesterday was quite demanding.
Did you see which tools are missing?
Yes, madam. We used many stainless-steel dough scrapers, but one brand was more flexible and more durable than the other.
The black-handled scraper worked well, but the white one cracked easily.
That matches what I saw. The black-handled scraper is definitely better.
We are going to order more of that model.
What about the digital ingredient scales?
We used the last few.
We also need moisture-checking paddles, but I think the bamboo paddle is sturdier than the plastic one.
The plastic paddles bent during the mixing process.
Then we will order bamboo paddles.
Did you check the pH testing spoons?
Last week, the supplier said the updated version was more reliable than the older batch.
Yes, madam. I tested them.
The new spoons had a better reading strip, but two spoons showed inaccurate colour changes.
I returned them to the supplier yesterday.
Good work. Accurate pH readings are essential for food safety.
Now, I’m going to prepare a new order.
What quantities do we need?
Order ten dough scrapers, eight ingredient scales because they are lighter and easier to calibrate, and six bamboo moisture-checking paddles.
What about fermentation-room thermometers?
The instructor said the metal-probe model was more accurate during yeast development.
Yes, madam. I compared them yesterday.
The metal-probe thermometer gave clearer readings.
The plastic-probe thermometer was slower and less stable.
Then we will switch to the metal-probe type.
Anything else?
Yes, madam. We also need batter-dispensing funnels.
The adjustable-flow model is stronger and more practical than the fixed-flow funnel.
Excellent. I’ll add them.
You are getting better at choosing suitable equipment.
Thank you, madam. I enjoy learning about food-processing tools.
